study.title: Large-scale pretrained frame generative model enables real-time low-dose DSA imaging: An AI system development and multi-center validation study

imaging.modality_detail: 2D-DSA (stationary C-arm) and rotational 3D-DSA video sequences; frame generation to reduce acquisition frame rate
imaging.territory_detail: Head and neck, thorax, abdomen, pelvis, limbs; external sets cerebrovascular

public_dataset_used.detail: Data-Netherlands drawn from the MR CLEAN Registry (2,396 patients, 16 hospitals); not stated to be publicly downloadable

data_released.detail: Data and code availability section referenced but not included in available text

annotation.annotator_expertise: No manual annotation (self-supervised); reader study by five interventional radiologists with 8-15 years of experience
annotation.inter_rater_value: Reader study: Kendall's W 0.565-0.791 (quality/lesion scoring); Fleiss' kappa 0.040-0.168 (visual Turing test)

task.task_description: Video frame interpolation (generation of 1, 2 or 3 intermediate frames after each real frame) from temporally undersampled DSA sequences to enable low-dose, real-time DSA imaging.
task.clinical_application: Radiation dose reduction (to 1/2-1/3 of clinical protocols) for patients and physicians during DSA-guided interventional procedures

temporal_evidence.quote: motion features are mapped at different times and decoded with structural features to compute flow and masks

method.pretraining: Self-supervised pretraining on partial 2D DV-MuRC data from five body parts (foundation model), then fine-tuned separately per body part and 2D/3D

evaluation.external_validation_detail: DV-MuRC centers 8-10 held out for testing (trained on centers 1-7); Data-Neusoft (475 patients, 9 Chinese hospitals, Neusoft 3D-DSA); Data-Netherlands (2,396 patients, 16 hospitals, MR CLEAN Registry 2D cerebral DSA)

other_limitations: Diseases not categorized in detail for clinical assessment
Actual dose values for low-frame-rate acquisition unavailable; dose savings estimated theoretically
3-frame generation yields inferior video clarity and fluency
2-frame generation unsatisfactory on external datasets; only 1-frame results reported
future_work: Develop a single generalized model for all body regions
Further verification in more clinical trials
Disease-level categorized analysis as DV-MuRC grows
Integration into DSA devices or standalone system for downstream tasks
